_source: ADR Chapter 3.3 — special provisions (API field: specialProvisions). PART 1 of several — covers numbers 16–290 (not all numbers in this range exist / some 'Reserved' or 'Deleted' entries omitted).

provisions.16: Samples of explosive substances/articles: carriage as directed by the competent authority (testing, classification, quality control, commercial samples). Unwetted/undesensitized ≤10 kg, wetted/desensitized ≤25 kg.
provisions.23: The substance presents a fire hazard only under extreme fire conditions in a confined space.
provisions.28: Carriage under Class 3/4.1 only when the diluent content does not fall below the established value during carriage.
provisions.32: In another form the substance is not subject to ADR.
provisions.37: If coated, not subject to ADR.
provisions.38: If containing ≤0.1% calcium carbide, not subject to ADR.
provisions.39: If containing <30% or ≥90% silicon, not subject to ADR.
provisions.43: If consigned as a pesticide, carriage under the appropriate pesticide entry per the relevant provisions.
provisions.45: Antimony sulfides/oxides containing ≤0.5% arsenic by mass are not subject to ADR.
provisions.47: Ferricyanides and ferrocyanides are not subject to ADR.
provisions.48: If >20% hydrogen cyanide, carriage is prohibited.
provisions.59: If ≤50% magnesium, not subject to ADR.
provisions.60: If the concentration is >72%, carriage is prohibited.
provisions.61: The supplementary technical name should be an ISO/WHO common name or the name of the active substance.
provisions.62: If ≤4% sodium hydroxide, not subject to ADR.
provisions.65: Aqueous hydrogen peroxide solutions <8% are not subject to ADR.
provisions.66: Cinnabar is not subject to ADR.
provisions.103: Carriage of ammonium nitrite and mixtures of inorganic nitrites with an ammonium salt is prohibited.
provisions.105: Nitrocellulose described under UN 2556/2557 may be classified under Class 4.1.
provisions.113: Carriage of chemically unstable mixtures is prohibited.
provisions.119: Refrigerating/air-conditioning machines are not subject to ADR if they contain <12 kg of Class 2 group A/O gas or <12 l of ammonia solution (UN 2672).
provisions.122: Subsidiary hazards, control/emergency temperatures and the UN number for organic peroxides — see 2.2.52.4, IBC520, T23.
provisions.127: Other inert materials with identical properties may be used as phlegmatizers.
provisions.131: After phlegmatization the substance must be significantly less sensitive than dry PETN.
provisions.135: The dihydrated sodium salt of dichloroisocyanuric acid does not meet the criteria of Class 5.1 (unless another class applies).
provisions.138: p-Bromobenzyl cyanide is not subject to ADR.
provisions.141: Products that have undergone sufficient heat treatment (no hazard remaining) are not subject to ADR.
provisions.142: Solvent-extracted soya bean meal with ≤1.5% oil, moisture content ≤11% and no flammable solvent is not subject to ADR.
provisions.144: Aqueous solutions with ≤24% alcohol by volume are not subject to ADR.
provisions.145: Alcoholic beverages of packing group III in receptacles ≤250 l are not subject to ADR.
provisions.152: Classification may depend on particle size/packaging — see 2.2.1.
provisions.153: The entry applies only where testing has shown no flammability/spontaneous ignition on contact with water and non-flammability of any gas evolved.
provisions.163: A substance named separately elsewhere may not be carried under this entry; up to 20% nitrocellulose is permitted (≤12.6% nitrogen, dry basis).
provisions.168: Asbestos fixed in a binder (no fibre release) is not subject to ADR; articles packaged so as to preclude release are likewise not subject to ADR.
provisions.169: Solid phthalic anhydride / tetrahydrophthalic anhydride with ≤0.05% maleic anhydride is not subject to ADR (molten, above flash point → UN 3256).
provisions.172: Radioactive material with a subsidiary hazard: packing group assigned according to the predominant subsidiary hazard, labels for each hazard, name supplemented with the constituent responsible for the hazard, transport document showing the label numbers in brackets after Class 7.
provisions.177: Barium sulfate is not subject to ADR.
provisions.178: The entry applies only where no other suitable entry exists, with the agreement of the competent authority of the country of origin.
provisions.181: Model No. 1 label required, unless the competent authority grants exemption based on tests showing absence of explosive properties.
provisions.182: Alkali metal group: lithium, sodium, potassium, rubidium, caesium.
provisions.183: Alkaline earth metal group: magnesium, calcium, strontium, barium.
provisions.188: Small lithium/sodium-ion cells and batteries are exempted from the rest of ADR under conditions: limits on lithium content/Wh (1 g/20 Wh per cell, 2 g/100 Wh per battery), Wh marking on the casing, packaging protecting against short circuit, marking for batteries (with exceptions for small quantities), 1.2 m free-drop test, max 30 kg gross per package (except for equipment).
provisions.190: Aerosol dispensers protected against accidental discharge; receptacles ≤50 ml without toxic constituents are not subject to ADR.
provisions.191: Small receptacles ≤50 ml without toxic constituents are not subject to ADR.
provisions.193: The entry applies only to ammonium nitrate based fertilizers meeting the classification procedure; those meeting the requirements are not subject to ADR.
provisions.194: Control/emergency temperatures and the UN number for self-reactive substances — see 2.2.41.4.
provisions.196: Formulations that neither detonate nor deflagrate in testing and are thermally stable (SADT ≥60°C for 50 kg) may be carried under this entry; others fall under Class 5.2.
provisions.198: Nitrocellulose solutions ≤20% may be carried as paint/perfume/printing ink under the relevant UN entries.
provisions.199: Lead compounds with a solubility ≤5% under the ISO 3711 test are regarded as insoluble and are not subject to ADR (provided no other classification criteria are met).
provisions.201: Lighters/lighter refills: design requirements, gas limit (10 g lighter, 65 g refill), protection against accidental discharge.
provisions.203: Not applicable to UN 2315 (liquid PCB) and UN 3432 (solid PCB).
provisions.207: Extrusion materials: polystyrene, poly(methyl methacrylate) or other polymeric materials.
provisions.208: Commercial calcium nitrate fertilizer (double salt) with ≤10% ammonium nitrate and ≥12% water of crystallization is not subject to ADR.
provisions.210: Toxins from infectious substances are to be classified under Class 6.2.
provisions.215: Applies only to technically pure material/formulations with a SADT >75°C that are not self-reactive substances; mixtures of ≤35% azodicarbonamide (≥65% inert material) not meeting other criteria are not subject to ADR.
provisions.216: Mixtures of solids (not subject to ADR) with flammable liquids may be carried without full Class 4.1 classification provided there is no leakage; packagings containing <10 ml of absorbed liquid (packing group II/III) are not subject to ADR.
provisions.217: As for 216, for toxic liquids (Class 6.1), except packing group I.
provisions.219: GMMOs/GMOs packed under P904 are not subject to the rest of ADR; where the criteria of 6.1/6.2 are met, the relevant provisions apply.
provisions.220: Only the technical name of the flammable liquid constituent may follow the proper shipping name in brackets.
provisions.221: Substances of packing group I may not be classified under this entry.
provisions.224: The substance must remain liquid under normal conditions (unless testing has shown lower sensitivity in the frozen state) and must not solidify above -15°C.
provisions.225: Fire extinguishers with cartridge-type igniters (≤3.2 g of deflagrating explosive substance) retain Class 2 group A/O classification; manufacturing requirements per the regulations of the producing country.
provisions.226: Formulations containing ≥30% non-volatile, non-flammable phlegmatizer are not subject to ADR.
provisions.227: Phlegmatization with water and an inert inorganic material: urea nitrate ≤75% by mass, no susceptibility to detonation in Test Series 1(a).
provisions.228: Mixtures not meeting the criteria for flammable gases are to be carried as UN 3163.
provisions.230: Lithium cells/batteries per 2.2.9.1.7.1, sodium-ion cells/batteries per 2.2.9.1.7.2.
provisions.235: Safety devices in vehicles/vessels (airbags, seat-belt pretensioners, pyromechanical devices) containing Class 1 and possibly other class materials.
provisions.236: Polyester resin kit: base material (Class 3/4.1, packing group II/III) plus hardener (organic peroxide type D/E/F, not temperature controlled); the quantity limit applies to the base material.
provisions.237: Filter membranes not susceptible to detonation (Test Series 1(a)); the competent authority may waive Class 4.1 requirements based on a burning-rate test.
provisions.238: Sealed batteries that have passed vibration and pressure tests; maintenance-free, no leakage at 55°C and with protected terminals, are not subject to ADR.
provisions.239: Sodium-sulfur batteries: no dangerous goods other than sodium/sulfur/sodium compounds; sealed metal casings required.
provisions.241: A homogeneous, low-nitrocellulose-content formulation showing no dangerous properties in Test Series 1(a)/2(b)/2(c) and Test N.1 is not subject to ADR.
provisions.242: Suitably formed sulfur (lumps, granules, pellets, prills, flakes) is not subject to ADR.
provisions.243: Petrol/motor fuel for spark-ignition engines falls under this entry regardless of volatility.
provisions.244: Covers aluminium drosses/skimmings, spent cathodes, cell linings and aluminium salt slags.
provisions.247: Alcoholic beverages 24–70% by volume, as an intermediate product, in wooden barrels of 250–500 l under specified conditions (sealing, ullage ≥3%, bungs upward, securing within a CSC container).
provisions.249: Stabilized cerium iron alloy with ≥10% iron is not subject to ADR.
provisions.250: Applies only to samples under the Chemical Weapons Convention, with authorization from the competent authority/OPCW, packed per ICAO Packing Instruction 623.
provisions.251: CHEMICAL KIT/FIRST AID KIT: only goods in excepted or limited quantities within the applicable limits, non-dangerously reacting components, total ≤1 l/1 kg; document must show the most severe packing group.
provisions.252: Hot concentrated ammonium nitrate solutions within limits (≤93% AN, ≥7% water, ≤0.2% combustible matter, chlorine ≤0.02%, pH 5-7, max 140°C) or concentrate solutions (≤80% AN, etc.) are not subject to ADR.
provisions.266: A substance with a lower alcohol/water/phlegmatizer content than specified is permitted only under special authorization of the competent authority.
provisions.267: Chlorate explosives, blasting type C, must be segregated from explosives containing ammonium nitrate or an ammonium salt.
provisions.270: Aqueous solutions of solid inorganic Class 5.1 nitrates do not meet Class 5.1 criteria if the concentration is ≤80% of saturation at the lowest temperature during carriage.
provisions.271: Phlegmatizers: lactose/glucose/similar ≥90% by mass; ≥98% is not subject to ADR; ≥90% is exempt from the Class 6.1 label.
provisions.272: May be carried under Class 4.1 only with special authorization from the competent authority (UN 0143/0150).
provisions.273: Maneb and preparations stabilized against self-heating need not be classified under 4.2 if a 1 m³ sample does not self-ignite (24-hour test at ≥75±2°C, internal temperature ≤200°C).
provisions.274: The provisions of 3.1.2.8 apply (technical name in brackets).
provisions.278: Classification and carriage only with authorization of the competent authority, based on Test Series 2 and 6(c).
provisions.279: Classification (including packing group) is based on documented cases of human poisoning, not on standard criteria.
provisions.280: Safety devices in vehicles/vessels (e.g. airbags) as components, following successful Test Series 6(c) without casing fragmentation.
provisions.283: Pneumatic shock absorbers/gas springs are not subject to ADR under design conditions (volume × pressure ≤80, burst strength, non-fragmenting material, quality system, prototype fire test).
provisions.284: Chemical oxygen generator with an oxidizing material: requirements for the initiating device, a 1.8 m drop test, and at least 2 safety features.
provisions.286: Nitrocellulose membrane filters ≤0.5 g each, individually packaged in articles or sealed packets, are not subject to ADR.
provisions.288: Classification and carriage only with authorization of the competent authority, based on Test Series 2 and 6(c).
provisions.289: Electric/pyrotechnic safety devices installed in vehicles/wagons/vessels (steering columns, door panels, seats) are not subject to ADR.
provisions.290: Radioactive material also meeting the criteria of other classes — rules for combined classification apply (continued further in the treaty text).
